task: Targeted primary-source collision and scope review for the forward/adjoint doubled lift and universal passive-output parity ambiguity
conclusion: The doubled adjoint lift is established skew-detailed-balance machinery. The finite-horizon closure and uniform passive-inference corollary is a prospective consequence; this bounded search did not establish its historical priority.

sources.title: Peskun–Tierney ordering for Markovian Monte Carlo: Beyond the reversible scenario
sources.read: Introduction; section 2.1 Definition 2; section 3.3 equations (5)–(7); section 4.1 Definition 4, Proposition 3 and Theorem 9
sources.bearing: Arbitrary adjoint-pair sign lift gives the exact discrete-time analogue; generator involution criteria cover the continuous-time structure. Strongest exact construction antecedent.

sources.title: Irreversible Monte Carlo algorithms for efficient sampling
sources.version: Published Physica D paper, author hosted
sources.read: Section 4, equations (2)–(4), and paragraph after equation (4)
sources.bearing: Two replicas, reversed replica fluxes, and free symmetric component of the switch rates. Earlier implementation; arbitrary adjoint-pair formulation is clearer in Andrieu–Livingstone.

sources.title: Lifting—A nonreversible Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm
sources.bearing: Corroborating description of established two-copy lifting and switch freedom; not the sole primary attribution.

sources.authors: Zacher, Lidschreiber, Cramer, Gagneur and Tresch
sources.title: Annotation of genomics data using bidirectional hidden Markov models unveils variations in Pol II transcription cycle
sources.read: Mathematical involution definitions, generalized detailed-balance and emission equations (2)–(6), and transition-matrix symmetrization; biological experimental methods were not needed
sources.bearing: Generalized-reversible HMM formalism; sequence orientation, not physical time reversal. Does not establish thermal realizability.

sources.title: Hidden entropy production and work fluctuations in an ideal active gas
sources.version: arXiv v3, September 2018; Physical Review E 98, 020604
sources.read: Introduction, Table I and initial discussion of model and propulsion parity
sources.bearing: Physical propulsion parity and eliminated fast degrees of freedom affect thermodynamic interpretation; assigning parity cannot substitute for physical energetic information.

sources.authors: Degünther, van der Meer and Seifert
sources.title: Fluctuating entropy production on the coarse-grained level: Inference and localization of irreversibility
sources.version: Inspected 2023 preprint; published Physical Review Research 6, 023175 (2024)
sources.read: Introduction; section IV A on underdamped odd variables; beginning of section IV B
sources.bearing: Odd-variable entropy and stationary boundary factors require physical conventions. Their stationary laws need not be parity symmetric; the proposed lift is parity symmetric.

sources.title: Perspective: Time irreversibility in systems observed at coarse resolution
sources.version: Published Journal of Chemical Physics 162, 090901, author hosted
sources.read: Introduction, discussion preceding section II, beginning of section III B, and inference-scope paragraphs
sources.bearing: Microscopic reversal, coarse-graining and physical model assumptions constrain entropy inference; hidden memory does not automatically carry a freely assignable sign reversal.

sources.title: Self-Propulsion Symmetries Determine Entropy Production of Active Particles with Hidden States
sources.version: Published abstract for Physical Review Letters 136, 198302, 2026-05-15; inspected preprint v1 July 2025
sources.read: Published abstract and first two preprint pages
sources.bearing: Specific active-particle hidden symmetries govern partial position-path entropy. Sign symmetry of a propulsion law is distinct from assigning physical time-reversal parity.

scope_guards: Exact projected-law preservation at zero switching may use a reducible hidden lift.
Positive switching supplies irreducibility and finite-horizon TV approximation, not exact law preservation or uniform infinite-horizon approximation.
The universal statement concerns passive stationary records, not automatically a specified reset or intervention interface.
Stationary preparation is a hypothesis; the slow switching limit may be excluded by additional preparation or mixing guarantees.
All-even hidden variables are one sufficient model restriction, not the uniquely necessary way to exclude competing parity completions.
An abstract generalized-reversible completion is not a demonstrated zero-dissipation physical device.
Duplicated ports violate a singleton-physical-port promise unless a separate port-preserving construction is verified.
root_followup: A proposed shared-port, doubled-interior exact excursion-kernel symmetrization was communicated to root for construction and independent verification. It is not attributed to the located literature.
search_boundary: Bounded targeted source check; no historical-priority claim, no full archive retrieval, no equipment or external experiment.
software_execution: No new executable test was needed for this source review.
